criteria.requirement: Extend CapturingLogger/Factory optional capacity=None with overflow drop_oldest/reject_new. Preserve default unlimited calls list and repr, all dynamic methods and one cached logger per factory. Nonnegative strict integer capacity, zero records nothing, total counts every call and dropped counts each unretained/evicted call. Snapshot returns tuple with copied kwargs containers but shared nested business objects. No concurrent producer guarantees or silently changing stats when caller manually edits calls.
